CAPABILITIES

Every capability in one eSignature platform.
📄

Document Preparation

Upload PDFs, configure fields, and prepare the document before it goes out.

👥

Recipient Management

Add signers, approvers, reviewers, and copy recipients — each with their own role and access level.

🔀

Parallel & Sequential Routing

Control the order documents move through participants. Send to everyone at once or in a defined sequence.

🔐

Signer Authentication

Confirm participant identity at signing with a secure invitation link and an email code, or by signing from a LAGDA account.

📋

Audit Trail

Every invitation, view, authentication event, signature, and completion is recorded with timestamp and evidence.

🔍

Document Verification

Completed documents receive a Verification ID and QR code that anyone can use to confirm status — no account needed.

📁

Templates

Save and reuse complete signing workflows — fields, routing, authentication, and branding — as reusable templates.

🏢

Team Workspaces

Manage multiple senders, shared templates, role-based access, and organization-wide settings in one workspace.

TWO EXPERIENCES

Designed differently for senders and recipients.

The sender configures and tracks. The recipient signs in a clean, guided experience, using a free LAGDA account.
